title: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to scale capacity efficiently, but expert parameters dominate memory even though only a few experts are activated per token: they account for over 90% of model size in modern MoE-MLLMs (e.g., 54 GB out of about 58 GB in BF16 for InternVL3.5-30B-A3B and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B). Expert pruning has emerged as an effective compression strategy, but existing methods aggregate importance uniformly across tokens, ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles for vision versus language processing. To address this, we propose MAEP (Modality-Aware Expert Pruning), a training-free framework that decomposes expert importance by modality in a single forward pass. translated_title: 面向基于混合专家的多模态大语言模型的模态感知专家剪枝
translated_abstract: 摘要：混合专家使多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够高效扩展模型容量，但尽管每个token仅激活少数专家，专家参数却占据了绝大部分内存：在现代MoE-MLLM中，专家参数占模型规模的90%以上（例如，InternVL3.5-30B-A3B和Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B在BF16精度下约58GB的模型中专家参数占54GB）。专家剪枝已成为一种有效的压缩策略，但现有方法在token间均匀聚合专家重要性，忽略了同一个专家在视觉处理与语言处理中可能扮演的不同角色。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MAEP（模态感知专家剪枝），这是一个无需训练的框架，可在单次前向传播中按模态分解专家重要性。MAEP引入了：(1) Delta-H输出（ΔH），一种重分布感知的度量指标，用于衡量移除某个专家后MoE输出的变化；(2) 低注意力视觉token作为视觉侧的剪枝信号
tldr: 提出了MAEP，一个无需训练的模态感知专家剪枝框架，通过ΔH输出度量和低注意力视觉token信号按模态分解专家重要性，实现对MoE多模态大语言模型的有效压缩。
en_tdlr: Proposes MAEP, a training-free modality-aware expert pruning framework that decomposes expert importance by modality using Delta-H output metrics and low-attention vision tokens to effectively compress MoE-based multimodal large language models.
